about: Every idea Daniel gave for Last Fire, and where it stands. The game shows this file (Esc, CHECKLIST). done = in the game and tested; in = in the game, not yet proven; next = being built now; later = agreed, not started; talk = still being discussed with him.

items.idea: Hardcore, fun, grown-up; never Minecraft or kid-like (no block world)
Feels brand new: no mechanic copied from another game, only the feelings
items.where: the design: light as currency, the network, Embers

items.idea: Real models for every gun, item and character (CC0)
Nothing bobs
items.where: camera and wraiths hold their height

items.idea: Hear your own and your friends' gunshots, from where they are
Smooth, clear, centered sights on every gun
items.where: guns drawn in their own pass

items.idea: Multiplayer from a link, up to 4, safe from strangers
items.where: piece 2: host checks every message, 6-letter codes, lock

items.idea: Endless world, drop in anytime
The world remembers everything
items.where: piece 3: saves, scars, light left lying out there

items.idea: No babysitting, logic wins
items.where: a lost night spills your light and ends; nothing is reset

items.idea: Deaths that feel fair (no unavoidable death)
items.where: robots: a perfect crew survives 12 of 12 nights

items.idea: Growing the fire is your choice (you decide when to provoke the dark)
Dev tools: restart, skip ahead, test, keep playing (like Era 1 and 2)
A checklist I can see, so no idea gets lost
The dark learns you, unsettling, never says what it learned
items.where: piece 4: recorded habits, robots that play like you; certification refuses what it cannot prove (not live yet)

items.idea: Only adapts when you get too comfortable
items.where: two calm nights with no falls

items.idea: One mind for every world (your daemon learns for Dalton's worlds too, free)
Clever engineering: mirrors, lenses, prisms that bend and focus light
Infinite progression, scaled by logic; grinders and casuals both fine
Movement that grows (more options as you go)
Awe: cosmic, unknowable; the sky and the far land get stranger
items.where: the ringed disc is the first piece

items.idea: Hyper-awareness
A villain who is iniquitous by nature
Random elements, dry dark humor, lots of mayhem
Hanging out with the guys, yet surviving alone in the dark
Maze Runner vibe, but not trapped: the maze is the obvious lore, so dark that people want to learn before entering
Who you are
